# Single Touch Payroll

Single Touch Payroll (STP) employer reporting guidelines – the requirements for reporting using STP-enabled software.

[**Overview and definitions**](https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/hiring-and-paying-your-workers/single-touch-payroll/overview-and-definitions)

Overview of how Single Touch Payroll works and definitions of terms used in these guidelines.

[**Rules of reporting through STP**](https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/hiring-and-paying-your-workers/single-touch-payroll/rules-of-reporting-through-stp)

Your Single Touch Payroll (STP) report will include minimum reporting requirements for you to meet your STP obligations.

[**Payments you must report through STP**](https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/hiring-and-paying-your-workers/single-touch-payroll/payments-you-must-report-through-stp)

Details on payments you must report, and the impact on BAS, PAYG withholding, payment summaries and annual reports.

[**How to report employment and tax information through STP**](https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/hiring-and-paying-your-workers/single-touch-payroll/how-to-report-employment-and-tax-information-through-stp)

What to do when you start reporting through Single Touch Payroll (STP).

[**Reporting the amounts you have paid**](https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/hiring-and-paying-your-workers/single-touch-payroll/reporting-the-amounts-you-have-paid)

What payments you need to report through Single Touch Payroll (STP) and how to do it.

[**Other components of your STP reporting**](https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/hiring-and-paying-your-workers/single-touch-payroll/other-components-of-your-stp-reporting)

There are other components you need to report through Single Touch Payroll (STP) that relate to employees themselves.

[**When an employee transfers or leaves**](https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/hiring-and-paying-your-workers/single-touch-payroll/when-an-employee-transfers-or-leaves)

The information you must include in your Single Touch Payroll (STP) report when employees leave.

[**Correcting information reported through STP**](https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/hiring-and-paying-your-workers/single-touch-payroll/correcting-information-reported-through-stp)

What you can correct through Single Touch Payroll (STP) and how to correct it.

[**Finalising your STP data**](https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/hiring-and-paying-your-workers/single-touch-payroll/finalising-your-stp-data)

Let us know your STP reporting is complete for an employee for a financial year by finalising your STP data.

[**Changing your payroll solution or employees’ Payroll IDs**](https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/hiring-and-paying-your-workers/single-touch-payroll/changing-your-payroll-solution-or-employees-payroll-ids)

How to change your payroll solution or employees' Payroll IDs during a financial year.

[**STP reporting issues and errors**](https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/hiring-and-paying-your-workers/single-touch-payroll/stp-reporting-issues-and-errors)

What issues and errors mean in your Single Touch Payroll (STP) reporting and steps you should take to address them.

[**Concessional reporting**](https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/hiring-and-paying-your-workers/single-touch-payroll/concessional-reporting)

There are various concessions, available to support employers with their STP reporting obligations.

[**Deferrals and exemptions**](https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/hiring-and-paying-your-workers/single-touch-payroll/deferrals-and-exemptions)

How to apply for deferrals or exemptions for Single Touch Payroll reporting.

[**Changes to award transport payments**](https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/hiring-and-paying-your-workers/single-touch-payroll/changes-to-award-transport-payments)

PAYG withholding and STP reporting for award transport payments changes from 1 October 2026.

[**STP reporting – Quick reference guide**](https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/hiring-and-paying-your-workers/single-touch-payroll/stp-phase-2-reporting-quick-reference-guide)

This quick reference guide shows how to report some common payment types through Single Touch Payroll (STP).
